parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 50 IDs in each request.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **DOMAIN**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn describe-tag-resources --resource-type DOMAIN --resource-id example.com --tag Value=value Key=key --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn DescribeTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'example.com' --Tag.1.Key key --Tag.1.Value value --ResourceType DOMAIN
